_note: 30 carte Asset dei Reclaimer (§1.5), lette dalle immagini del modulo Vassal. value = Risorse fornite scartando la carta; bonus_operation/bonus_value = valore maggiorato se usata per pagare quella specifica Operazione. kind: capability (bonus permanente + Operazione gratuita in 2 spazi una tantum), event (Evento giocabile al posto della carta corrente), resource (solo Risorse). np_star = stella usata dalle regole Non-Player.

cards.title: Subdermal Weaponry
cards.subtitle: Hit and fade
cards.text: CR Attack removes an additional enemy piece for each successful die roll.

cards.title: Dust-Adaptation
cards.subtitle: The wastes will hide us
cards.text: CR may select spaces with Raging Storms for any Operations, Special Activities, or Events.

cards.title: Enhanced Metabolism
cards.subtitle: The new Martians
cards.text: After each Assault that removes any CR forces, CR may place a Rebel into 1 space where CR forces were removed.

cards.title: The Mind Twister
cards.subtitle: Hear us now, we are of Mars
cards.text: Purify removes an additional enemy piece in each selected space.

cards.title: Neural Conditioning
cards.subtitle: Be at peace, we mean you no harm, obey
cards.text: CR Rally in spaces without a CR Base may place Rebels up to Population or flip all CR Rebels to Hidden.

cards.title: Deep Tunneling
cards.subtitle: Mars will shelter his chosen
cards.text: CR forces cannot be removed by Bombard.

cards.title: Children of the Desert
cards.subtitle: Mastery of the land
cards.text: Free Travel to 1 Desert and any adjacent Deserts, then free Attack in each destination space.

cards.title: Weaponized Asteroid
cards.subtitle: Catastrophic impact
cards.text: Place 2 Damage in a Labyrinth, then remove half the units there (rounded up).

cards.title: The Reclaimer Faith
cards.subtitle: We are everywhere
cards.text: Place 1 CR Base into each of 3 spaces with no other Faction's forces.

cards.title: Converts
cards.subtitle: Become a real child of Mars
cards.text: Replace up to 4 RD Rebels with CR Rebels.

cards.title: Church Assets
cards.subtitle: A legitimate faith
cards.text: Draw 1 Asset card for each Labyrinth with CR forces, then place 1 CR Base in each of 2 Labyrinths.

cards.title: The Lost Patrol
cards.subtitle: Swallowed without a trace
cards.text: Remove all COIN units from 1 Desert, then place 1 Damage on an adjacent Labyrinth.

cards.title: The Ma'adim
cards.subtitle: Church luminary martyred
cards.text: Flip all CR Rebels to Hidden and move up to 6 CR Rebels to any 1 Desert.

cards.title: Re-Engineering
cards.text: If discarded to claim First Eligible, draw 1 Asset card.

cards.title: Secret Donors
cards.text: If discarded to claim First Eligible, draw 1 Asset card.

cards.title: MPS Uplink Hacked
cards.subtitle: Uplinks hacked
cards.text: Treat spaces with Satellites as if they contained an additional CR Base for the purpose of all Operations.

cards.title: AI Unleashed
cards.subtitle: A ghost in the machine
cards.text: Ransack additionally reduces MG Resources by 3 or Profits by 1.

cards.title: Genetic Masking
cards.subtitle: Forensics baffled
cards.text: Spaces with a CR Base count as having 2 fewer COIN units for Secure and Recon.

cards.title: Ares Rockets
cards.subtitle: Clear the skies of Mars
cards.text: CR Attack may remove Satellites from anywhere on Mars.

cards.title: Loyalty
cards.subtitle: Desertion
cards.text: Remove up to 2 Security or MG Troops each from 4 spaces on Mars without Support.

cards.title: Remote Base
cards.subtitle: Unknown armies
cards.text: Place a CR Base and 2 CR Rebels in an Unpopulated Desert. Flip that Base to its Conversion Center side and draw 1 Asset card.

cards.title: Pilgrimage
cards.subtitle: When the walls fell
cards.text: Move up to 4 CR Rebels to one Labyrinth no more than 2 spaces away from any of them. Place 1 Damage in that Labyrinth, then remove up to 3 Population markers from Displaced Population.
